title: Student Lesson Report – Academic Year – Current-year lessons – Includes in-year past and future lessons only
description: AC 02.1 — Decision Table / Boundary Value Analysis — The report includes the selected student's lessons inside the academic-year range and excludes an outside-range lesson.
preconditions:
- Centre Staff A is logged in to Salesforce with access to Student A.
- The report's configured current academic year is AY 2026 from 2026-04-01 through 2027-03-31.
- Student A has Lesson Past on 2026-05-15.
- Student A has Lesson Future on 2027-02-15.
- Student A has Lesson Outside AY on 2026-03-31.
steps_actions: 1. Centre Staff A opens Student A's Student Lesson Report.\n2. Centre Staff A locates Lesson Past and Lesson Future in the report.\n3. Centre Staff A searches the report rows for Lesson Outside AY.
steps_result: 1. The report opens for Student A using the current academic-year filter.\n2. The report shows both Lesson Past and Lesson Future.\n3. The report does not show Lesson Outside AY.
suite: EEA | Core | Student's Lesson Report or Lesson Classroom info in Lesson object

title: Student Lesson Report – Lesson Date – JST/UTC date boundary – Applies the intended Japan date and AY scope
description: AC 02.1 — Boundary Value Analysis / Regression — A lesson at the JST↔UTC calendar-date boundary remains in the intended Japan academic-year scope.
preconditions:
- Centre Staff A is logged in to Salesforce with access to Student A.
- The report's configured current academic year is AY 2026 from 2026-04-01 through 2027-03-31 in Japan Standard Time.
- Student A has Boundary Lesson scheduled for 2026-04-01 00:30 JST which is 2026-03-31 15:30 UTC.
- Student A has Outside Boundary Lesson scheduled for 2026-03-31 23:30 JST which is 2026-03-31 14:30 UTC.
steps_actions: 1. Centre Staff A opens Student A's Student Lesson Report.\n2. Centre Staff A locates Boundary Lesson in the report.\n3. Centre Staff A searches the report rows for Outside Boundary Lesson.
steps_result: 1. The report opens with AY 2026 scope evaluated for Japan Standard Time.\n2. The report shows Boundary Lesson with Lesson Date 2026-04-01 and places it in AY 2026.\n3. The report does not show Outside Boundary Lesson in AY 2026.
suite: EEA | Core | Student's Lesson Report or Lesson Classroom info in Lesson object

title: Student Lesson Report – Report row – Populated lesson – Shows every required field together
description: AC 02.2 — Component — A populated lesson row presents the complete field set required for communication and attendance work.
preconditions:
- Centre Staff A is logged in to Salesforce with access to Student A.
- Student A has Lesson Tokyo 01 in the current academic year.
- Lesson Tokyo 01 has Location Tokyo Center, Start Time 09:00, End Time 10:00, Teacher Taro, Classroom Room A, Attendance Status Present, and a linked Student Session.
steps_actions: 1. Centre Staff A opens Student A's Student Lesson Report.\n2. Centre Staff A reads the Lesson Tokyo 01 row.
steps_result: 1. The report opens for Student A.\n2. The same row shows Student Name, Lesson Date, Location, Start Time, End Time, Lesson Name, Lesson Teacher, Lesson Classroom, Attendance Status, Absent Reason, and Student Session.
steps_data: 1. Student = Student A; Lesson = Lesson Tokyo 01\n2. Location = Tokyo Center; Time = 09:00–10:00; Teacher = Taro; Classroom = Room A; Status = Present
suite: EEA | Core | Student's Lesson Report or Lesson Classroom info in Lesson object
